title: ÐMaps JSON claim (p: Ð:MAPS)
$comment: Shape of the JSON form only. The text form is the exact body <n>.dogemap (see text_claim). Validity also needs the JSON profile, a text/plain* or application/json* content type, block_height <= confirmation height, and first-inscription-wins (docs/INDEXING.md §2.2, §4). Keys other than p, op and title.block_height are ignored.

text_claim.$comment: The text form, as a pattern over the whole body (UTF-8 = ASCII here). At most 10 digits.
